tools.name: sill_listContents
tools.description: Read cards page by page with limit 1–100. No keyword or type filter. Follow next_cursor; use only a returned sync_cursor as since. Card contract 4.2.0: type selects the card kind; summary is plain text for the card face; body is one CommonMark Markdown string, never an array or JSON-encoded string. Use native JSON objects/arrays/numbers/booleans for structured fields. Omit unknown facts. No points, card.meta or files[].meta/time. Personal notes belong to state.note. Dates retain their precision; scheduling timestamps use Unix milliseconds; media offsets and durations use seconds.

expected_owner.description: Optional account guard from an authenticated host; grants no permissions. Keep it unchanged when retrying a request.

audioUrl.description: Podcast audio URL, read only during playback. Not an acquisition or sync source.

chapters.description: Media only: {start,title} chapters, with start in seconds, strictly increasing and within known duration. Count must not exceed chapterCount. Never invent timestamps.

transcript.description: Media only: actual timestamped transcript {start,text}; start in seconds, strictly increasing and within known duration. Ordinary notes belong in body.

attachments.description: Mail only: actual attachments {name,url?,mimeType?,sizeBytes?}; no binary or base64. An explicit [] clears the list and overrides the legacy attachment label.

pullRequest.description: Required for type=pr only: repository (owner/repo), positive number, state and observedAt (offset ISO datetime). Optional branches, author, reviewers, checks, statistics and files reflect observed evidence. Only completed checks may have conclusion; listed files cannot exceed known changedFiles. Omit unknown counts, retain known zeros. Never presented as live GitHub state.

title.description: Specific plain-text title; do not place the full body here.

summary.description: Card face summary: one or two plain-text sentences for the feed card and search results. Not shown in the detail; put all detail text in body.

authors.description: Original content authors, not sources or the writing agent. Applies to article, note, mail, media, digest, suggestion and file.

publisher.description: Article, note, mail, media, digest, suggestion or file only: original publisher, separate from authors and sources.

publishedAt.description: Original publication date or offset datetime. Preserve date-only precision.

modifiedAt.description: Original content modification date, not the Sill updated_at timestamp.

savedAt.description: Save date in the external source, not Sill created_at or personal addedAt.

bodyCoverage.description: Article, note, mail, digest, suggestion or file only: saved body coverage. full=complete, excerpt=partial, summary=summary only, none=no body. Never label an excerpt as full.

readingEstimate.description: Article, note, mail, digest, suggestion or file only: estimated reading seconds, not actual reading time. provided requires a known external estimate; calculated requires method and saved bodyCoverage. full calculations require bodyCoverage=full. Recompute or set null when body changes; null explicitly clears the estimate.

section.description: Article section name, separate from tags.

sentAt.description: Mail only: actual send datetime with timezone; date-only values are invalid.

recipients.description: Mail only: actual recipient names or addresses. Do not assume the current user is a recipient.

project.description: Task or reminder only: existing project name and optional HTTP(S) link.

timeZone.description: Event only: IANA timezone identifier such as Asia/Shanghai; numeric offsets are not timezone identifiers.

chapterCount.description: Media only: known total chapter count, at least chapters.length; omit when unknown.

takenAt.description: Photo only: actual capture date or offset datetime; retain date-only precision.

caption.description: Photo only: factual image description, not a personal note.

coverageStart.description: Digest only: coverage start in Unix milliseconds; supply with coverageEnd.

coverageEnd.description: Digest only: coverage end in Unix milliseconds, strictly after coverageStart.

form.description: Optional existing template hint, not HTML/CSS or a content type. Omit for the default layout.

image.description: Built-in illustrative asset ID only, not an image URL or upload. Required for video; never substitute for a real user photo.

tags.description: Content tags. Personal edited tags use state.tags plus state.tagsEdited.

url.description: Original HTTP(S) source link; video uses its platform page URL. Not an upload or fetch instruction.

sources.description: Acquisition sources as {name,kind}; not authors, publisher or sender. Records provenance without connecting to the source.

why.description: Suggestion rationale: reason plus optional factual basis. Keep recommendation distinct from evidence and do not execute it automatically.

sender.description: Actual mail sender; never infer from acquisition source.

location.description: Known event location; omit if unavailable.

meeting.description: Existing meeting reference {name,url,code?}, not a request to create a meeting. Never store credentials in the URL or code.

media.description: Media subtype, independent of type=media and file MIME type.

duration.description: Known media duration in integer seconds. Unknown is omitted, not zero.

files.description: File descriptions: name, optional MIME type, integer sizeBytes, original modifiedAt and HTTP(S) url. No binary/base64 upload; no meta/time. File cards require a nonempty list.

photos.description: Photo card built-in illustrative asset IDs only; not real photo uploads or URLs.

attachment.description: Legacy single mail attachment label. Prefer structured attachments for new cards; no uploaded file data.

tasks.description: Task card actionable subtasks as {id,text,done?}; use nonempty tasks with unique stable IDs. Markdown checkboxes do not create interactive tasks.

start.description: Event start as Unix milliseconds, greater than zero; pair with end.

end.description: Event end as Unix milliseconds, strictly later than start.

due.description: Known task/reminder due time as Unix milliseconds; recording it does not schedule an external notification.

time.description: Card timeline time in Unix milliseconds; separate from original publication, send and save dates.

people.description: Known people involved, such as task participants or event attendees; do not invent assignments.

related.description: Real Sill card IDs read under the current permissions; not titles or URLs.

priority.description: Priority from 0 to 10, only when requested or supported by source facts.

playbackPosition.description: Actual playback position in seconds, separate from reading progress; saving position does not mark read.

tools.name: sill_createContent
tools.description: Create one card with body:{type,title,...fields}; its nested body is Markdown. Prefer typed fields for tasks, meetings, files, mail attachments, media chapters/transcript and PR snapshots. PR requires pullRequest with repository, number, state and observedAt. Read the returned ID to verify saved fields. Card contract 4.2.0: type selects the card kind; summary is plain text for the card face; body is one CommonMark Markdown string, never an array or JSON-encoded string. Dates retain their precision; scheduling timestamps use Unix milliseconds; media offsets and durations use seconds. Use a new idempotency_key for a new write; after an unknown result, verify first and retry only with the same key and identical arguments. A Sill write does not execute an external action.

idempotency_key.description: New UUID per logical write. Reuse the exact key and arguments only when retrying that same write after checking an unknown result.

audioUrl.description: Podcast audio URL, read only during playback. Not an acquisition or sync source.

chapters.description: Media only: {start,title} chapters, with start in seconds, strictly increasing and within known duration. Count must not exceed chapterCount. Never invent timestamps.

transcript.description: Media only: actual timestamped transcript {start,text}; start in seconds, strictly increasing and within known duration. Ordinary notes belong in body.

attachments.description: Mail only: actual attachments {name,url?,mimeType?,sizeBytes?}; no binary or base64. An explicit [] clears the list and overrides the legacy attachment label.

pullRequest.description: Required for type=pr only: repository (owner/repo), positive number, state and observedAt (offset ISO datetime). summary.description: Card face summary: one or two plain-text sentences for the feed card and search results. Not shown in the detail; put all detail text in body.

related.description: Real Sill card IDs read under the current permissions; not titles or URLs.

priority.description: Priority from 0 to 10, only when requested or supported by source facts.

audioUrl.description: Podcast audio URL, read only during playback. Not an acquisition or sync source.

chapters.description: Media only: {start,title} chapters, with start in seconds, strictly increasing and within known duration. Count must not exceed chapterCount. Never invent timestamps.

transcript.description: Media only: actual timestamped transcript {start,text}; start in seconds, strictly increasing and within known duration. Ordinary notes belong in body.

attachments.description: Mail only: actual attachments {name,url?,mimeType?,sizeBytes?}; no binary or base64. An explicit [] clears the list and overrides the legacy attachment label.

pullRequest.description: Required for type=pr only: repository (owner/repo), positive number, state and observedAt (offset ISO datetime). Optional branches, author, reviewers, checks, statistics and files reflect observed evidence. Only completed checks may have conclusion; listed files cannot exceed known changedFiles. Omit unknown counts, retain known zeros. Never presented as live GitHub state.

id.description: Card ID. Generated by single-card create; caller supplies a new ID for batch card.upsert.

type.description: Card kind. New cards use the supported cardTypes; media distinguishes video and podcast.

title.description: Specific plain-text title; do not place the full body here.

summary.description: Card face summary: one or two plain-text sentences for the feed card and search results. Not shown in the detail; put all detail text in body.

authors.description: Original content authors, not sources or the writing agent. Applies to article, note, mail, media, digest, suggestion and file.

publisher.description: Article, note, mail, media, digest, suggestion or file only: original publisher, separate from authors and sources.

publishedAt.description: Original publication date or offset datetime. Preserve date-only precision.

modifiedAt.description: Original content modification date, not the Sill updated_at timestamp.

savedAt.description: Save date in the external source, not Sill created_at or personal addedAt.

bodyCoverage.description: Article, note, mail, digest, suggestion or file only: saved body coverage. full=complete, excerpt=partial, summary=summary only, none=no body. Never label an excerpt as full.

readingEstimate.description: Article, note, mail, digest, suggestion or file only: estimated reading seconds, not actual reading time. provided requires a known external estimate; calculated requires method and saved bodyCoverage. full calculations require bodyCoverage=full. Recompute or set null when body changes; null explicitly clears the estimate.

section.description: Article section name, separate from tags.

sentAt.description: Mail only: actual send datetime with timezone; date-only values are invalid.

recipients.description: Mail only: actual recipient names or addresses. Do not assume the current user is a recipient.

project.description: Task or reminder only: existing project name and optional HTTP(S) link.

timeZone.description: Event only: IANA timezone identifier such as Asia/Shanghai; numeric offsets are not timezone identifiers.

chapterCount.description: Media only: known total chapter count, at least chapters.length; omit when unknown.

takenAt.description: Photo only: actual capture date or offset datetime; retain date-only precision.

caption.description: Photo only: factual image description, not a personal note.

coverageStart.description: Digest only: coverage start in Unix milliseconds; supply with coverageEnd.

coverageEnd.description: Digest only: coverage end in Unix milliseconds, strictly after coverageStart.

form.description: Optional existing template hint, not HTML/CSS or a content type. Omit for the default layout.

image.description: Built-in illustrative asset ID only, not an image URL or upload. Required for video; never substitute for a real user photo.

tags.description: Content tags. Personal edited tags use state.tags plus state.tagsEdited.

body.description: Detail text as one Markdown (CommonMark) string: headings, lists, quotes, emphasis, links and code. Use actual newline characters; serialize JSON once. Do not send an array, a JSON document string, or an enclosing Markdown fence. Raw HTML is shown as text, images are not loaded, and links must use http, https or mailto.

url.description: Original HTTP(S) source link; video uses its platform page URL. Not an upload or fetch instruction.

sources.description: Acquisition sources as {name,kind}; not authors, publisher or sender. Records provenance without connecting to the source.

why.description: Suggestion rationale: reason plus optional factual basis. Keep recommendation distinct from evidence and do not execute it automatically.

sender.description: Actual mail sender; never infer from acquisition source.

location.description: Known event location; omit if unavailable.

meeting.description: Existing meeting reference {name,url,code?}, not a request to create a meeting. Never store credentials in the URL or code.

media.description: Media subtype, independent of type=media and file MIME type.

duration.description: Known media duration in integer seconds. Unknown is omitted, not zero.

files.description: File descriptions: name, optional MIME type, integer sizeBytes, original modifiedAt and HTTP(S) url. No binary/base64 upload; no meta/time. File cards require a nonempty list.

photos.description: Photo card built-in illustrative asset IDs only; not real photo uploads or URLs.

attachment.description: Legacy single mail attachment label. Prefer structured attachments for new cards; no uploaded file data.

tasks.description: Task card actionable subtasks as {id,text,done?}; use nonempty tasks with unique stable IDs. Markdown checkboxes do not create interactive tasks.

start.description: Event start as Unix milliseconds, greater than zero; pair with end.

end.description: Event end as Unix milliseconds, strictly later than start.

due.description: Known task/reminder due time as Unix milliseconds; recording it does not schedule an external notification.

time.description: Card timeline time in Unix milliseconds; separate from original publication, send and save dates.

people.description: Known people involved, such as task participants or event attendees; do not invent assignments.

related.description: Real Sill card IDs read under the current permissions; not titles or URLs.

priority.description: Priority from 0 to 10, only when requested or supported by source facts.

playbackPosition.description: Actual playback position in seconds, separate from reading progress; saving position does not mark read.
